source.text_it: L’eccessiva pressione di gonfiaggio di uno pneumatico ne diminuisce il diametro di rotolamento

records.localized_text: Excessive tire pressure reduces rolling diameter.

source.text_it: L’eccessiva pressione di gonfiaggio di uno pneumatico non comporta problemi se la temperatura esterna è inferiore a 10°C

records.localized_text: Excessive tire pressure causes no problems if outside temperature is below 10°C.

source.text_it: Per migliorare la stabilità del veicolo, nelle forti discese è bene diminuire la pressione degli pneumatici posteriori di mezzo bar

records.localized_text: To improve stability on steep descents, rear tire pressure should be reduced by half a bar.

source.text_it: Sui veicoli dotati di sospensioni pneumatiche, la pressione di gonfiaggio deve essere ridotta di 0,2 bar

records.localized_text: On vehicles with air suspension, tire pressure must be reduced by 0.2 bar.

source.text_it: Sui veicoli dotati di sospensioni pneumatiche, non è necessario il periodico controllo della pressione di gonfiaggio

records.localized_text: On vehicles with air suspension, periodic tire pressure checks are unnecessary.

source.text_it: Alla fine di un viaggio, uno pneumatico troppo gonfio ha il battistrada più caldo ai bordi

records.localized_text: At the end of a journey, an overinflated tire's tread is hottest at the edges.

source.text_it: L’insufficiente pressione di gonfiaggio di uno pneumatico comporta una sua maggior usura al centro del battistrada

source.text_it: L’eccessiva pressione di gonfiaggio di uno pneumatico comporta una sua maggior usura ai bordi del battistrada

records.localized_text: Excessive tire pressure causes greater tread-edge wear.

source.text_it: Una pressione di gonfiaggio dello pneumatico inferiore del 10% rispetto al valore consigliato facilita le manovre di parcheggio

records.localized_text: Tire pressure 10% below the recommended value makes parking maneuvers easier.

source.text_it: L’insufficiente pressione di gonfiaggio di uno pneumatico comporta una sua miglior aderenza su terreno innevato

records.localized_text: Insufficient tire pressure improves grip on snow.

source.text_it: Una pressione di gonfiaggio dello pneumatico superiore del 10% rispetto al valore consigliato non modifica il confort di marcia

records.localized_text: Tire pressure 10% above the recommended value does not change ride comfort.

source.text_it: Una pressione di gonfiaggio dello pneumatico superiore del 10% rispetto al valore consigliato permette un risparmio di carburante

records.localized_text: Tire pressure 10% above the recommended value saves fuel.

source.text_it: Una pressione di gonfiaggio dello pneumatico superiore del 10% rispetto al valore consigliato riduce la distanza di frenatura

records.localized_text: Tire pressure 10% above the recommended value reduces braking distance.

source.text_it: La più importante operazione di manutenzione degli pneumatici è il periodico controllo della pressione di gonfiaggio

records.localized_text: The most important tire maintenance operation is periodic pressure checking.

source.text_it: La corretta pressione di gonfiaggio degli pneumatici deve essere uguale a quella indicata dalla casa costruttrice dello pneumatico stesso

records.localized_text: Correct tire pressure must equal the value specified by the tire manufacturer.

source.text_it: Il controllo della pressione deve essere effettuato su tutti gli pneumatici, compreso quello della ruota di scorta

records.localized_text: Pressure must be checked on all tires, including the spare.

source.text_it: Causa di consumo irregolare di uno pneumatico è la mancata equilibratura della ruota su cui è montato

records.localized_text: An unbalanced wheel can cause uneven tire wear.

source.text_it: Causa di consumo irregolare di uno pneumatico sono i non corretti angoli di convergenza o di campanatura delle ruote

records.localized_text: Incorrect wheel toe or camber angles can cause uneven tire wear.

source.text_it: Causa di consumo irregolare di uno pneumatico è la cattiva registrazione degli organi di direzione

records.localized_text: Poor adjustment of steering components can cause uneven tire wear.

source.text_it: Gli pneumatici con tagli sui fianchi devono essere sostituiti

records.localized_text: Tires with sidewall cuts must be replaced.

source.text_it: La pressione di gonfiaggio degli pneumatici deve essere misurata a caldo, dopo aver percorso diversi chilometri, in modo da fargli raggiungere la giusta temperatura di esercizio

records.localized_text: Tire pressure must be measured hot after several kilometres so the tires reach operating temperature.

source.text_it: Lo pneumatico che presenti, a caldo, una pressione superiore a quella prevista a freddo, deve essere immediatamente sgonfiato

source.text_it: La pressione di gonfiaggio degli pneumatici è stabilita dal conducente in funzione del tipo di carico trasportato e della temperatura dell'asfalto

source.text_it: I difetti di convergenza delle ruote non influiscono sul consumo uniforme degli pneumatici

records.localized_text: Load distribution does not affect tire wear.

rows.text: At the same load, increasing pressure makes the tire flatten less: its rolling radius tends to increase, not decrease.
evidence: https://pure.tue.nl/ws/files/46975582/674114-1.pdf, § 4.2 e fig. 4.12 — nelle prove il raggio effettivo di rotolamento aumenta leggermente con la pressione.

rows.text: Cold weather does not remove the risks of overinflation: excessive pressure can make a tire more vulnerable to impacts and affect vehicle handling.
evidence: https://www.bridgestonetire.com/content/dam/consumer/bst/na/warranties/bs_maintenance_and_safety_ca_en_2024v2.pdf, § 4 — controllare a freddo tutte le gomme, inclusa la scorta; pressione secondo il veicolo; pressione scorretta danneggia pneumatici e comportamento.

rows.text: Do not deflate the rear tires by half a bar for a descent: insufficient pressure can impair stability and grip. Use the pressure specified for the load.
evidence: https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — pressione corretta per carico e impiego; controllo a freddo; pressioni errate compromettono sicurezza, aderenza e comfort.

rows.text: Air suspension does not require a fixed reduction in tire pressure. Follow the value specified for the tires, load and use.
evidence: https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — pressione corretta per carico e impiego; controllo a freddo; pressioni errate compromettono sicurezza, aderenza e comfort.

rows.text: Air suspension does not replace tire checks: pressure must still be checked periodically on these vehicles.
evidence: https://www.bridgestonetire.com/content/dam/consumer/bst/na/warranties/bs_maintenance_and_safety_ca_en_2024v2.pdf, § 4 — controllare a freddo tutte le gomme, inclusa la scorta; pressione secondo il veicolo; pressione scorretta danneggia pneumatici e comportamento.

rows.text: Overinflation tends to concentrate the load at the center of the tread; it does not automatically mean that the edges will be hotter after a trip.
evidence: Michelin, center wear, https://www.michelinman.com/auto/auto-tips-and-advice/tire-damage/wear-problems/symptom-wear-in-center — excess inflation associates central wear; Waikato tyre-contact research printed pp.17–18 (PDF pp.30–31), https://researchcommons.waikato.ac.nz/server/api/core/bitstreams/ed1d9813-eac5-4589-ba1b-7c063f4adc71/content — racing-tyre model associates excess pressure with center contact/heating, not automatic hotter shoulders in every vehicle.

rows.text: Underinflation tends to make the tread shoulders work and wear more, rather than the center.
evidence: https://www.michelinman.com/auto/auto-tips-and-advice/tire-damage/wear-problems/symptom-wear-on-both-edges — il sottogonfiaggio aumenta l’usura sulle spalle.

rows.text: Overinflation tends to concentrate load and therefore wear at the center of the tread, rather than at the edges.
evidence: https://www.michelinman.com/auto/auto-tips-and-advice/tire-damage/wear-problems/symptom-wear-in-center — sovragonfiaggio concentra il carico al centro del battistrada.

rows.text: Lowering pressure below the recommended value is not a way to make parking easier: it can increase steering effort and impair handling.
evidence: https://doi.org/10.4271/2016-36-0068 — prova di sterzata da fermo su autocarro: la bassa pressione aumenta le forze sullo sterzo; effetto dipendente dalle condizioni.

https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — pressione corretta per carico e impiego; controllo a freddo; pressioni errate compromettono sicurezza, aderenza e comfort.

rows.text: On snow, do not assume an underinflated tire has more grip: insufficient pressure affects handling. Maintain the pressure specified for the conditions of use.
evidence: https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — pressione corretta per carico e impiego; controllo a freddo; pressioni errate compromettono sicurezza, aderenza e comfort.

rows.text: Excessive pressure can make the ride harsher and reduce comfort; comfort does not necessarily remain unchanged.
evidence: https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — pressione corretta per carico e impiego; controllo a freddo; pressioni errate compromettono sicurezza, aderenza e comfort.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE, but a saving is possible under some conditions. In a truck study higher pressures reduced rolling resistance and a model estimated lower fuel use; the test reference pressure was not identified as the manufacturer’s recommended pressure. Use the pressure specified for the vehicle and load.
evidence: Bachman (2018), Do Changes in Temperature and Inflation Pressure Affect Rolling Resistance During Road and Track Testing for Fuel Economy of Class 8 Tractor-Trailers?, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6198682/ — indexed full-text passage and Tables 3–4: SAE J1269 results show lower rolling resistance at 110% reference test pressure and model-estimated fuel decrease; reference test pressure not established as each vehicle manufacturer’s recommended pressure, and modeled savings not universal road proof. Direct full-text access encountered a challenge; indexed extract inspected.

Michelin, Truck and bus tyre: the right pressure, https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — choose suitable pressure for load and operating conditions; not evidence of universal fuel effect or official rationale.

rows.text: Excessive pressure does not guarantee a shorter stopping distance: it can reduce grip. Maintain the prescribed pressure for proper braking.
evidence: https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — pressione corretta per carico e impiego; controllo a freddo; pressioni errate compromettono sicurezza, aderenza e comfort.

evidence: https://www.bridgestonetire.com/content/dam/consumer/bst/na/warranties/bs_maintenance_and_safety_ca_en_2024v2.pdf, § 4 — controllare a freddo tutte le gomme, inclusa la scorta; pressione secondo il veicolo; pressione scorretta danneggia pneumatici e comportamento.

rows.text: For heavy-vehicle tires, use the tire manufacturer’s guidance appropriate to the load and configuration, while also observing the vehicle and wheel requirements.
evidence: Continental Truck, Bus & Trailer Tire Product Data Guide 2025, https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/market-content/us/truck/literature/catalogs/TT-CO-BK-DATA.pdf — cold inflation load tables, correct tire/rim combination and wheel limits; manufacturer-specific data.
Michelin, truck and bus tyre pressure, https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — pressure chosen for load and operation.

rows.text: The spare tire can also lose pressure while unused. Check it along with the fitted tires so it is ready when needed.
evidence: https://www.bridgestonetire.com/content/dam/consumer/bst/na/warranties/bs_maintenance_and_safety_ca_en_2024v2.pdf, § 4 — controllare a freddo tutte le gomme, inclusa la scorta; pressione secondo il veicolo; pressione scorretta danneggia pneumatici e comportamento.

rows.text: An unbalanced wheel can cause vibration and uneven tread wear. Balancing corrects the imbalance of the wheel and tire assembly.

https://www.michelinman.com/auto/assistance/glossary — equilibratura dell’insieme ruota e pneumatico.

rows.text: Incorrect toe or camber changes contact with the road and can cause uneven tread wear.
evidence: https://www.michelinman.com/auto/assistance/michelin-faqs — convergenza e campanatura non corrette fra le cause di usura su una spalla.

rows.text: Incorrect steering adjustment can alter wheel alignment and cause uneven wear. Have the alignment checked and corrected.
evidence: https://business.michelinman.com/tips-suggestions/truck/uneven-commercial-truck-tire-wear — usura irregolare: inflazione, assetto, equilibratura e distribuzione del carico sono possibili fattori.

rows.text: The quiz marks this TRUE: a sidewall cut can damage the structure and requires specialist assessment; some tyres must be replaced. Certain commercial tyres may be structurally repaired within specific limits after inspection. A cut is not automatically repairable, and the technical guide does not establish an Italian legal exemption.
evidence: USTMA, Care and Service of Commercial Truck and Bus Tires (2017), printed pp.43–44, https://www.ustires.org/sites/default/files/2024-08/Care%20and%20Service%20of%20Commercial%20Truck%20and%20Bus%20Tires%202017%20.pdf — certain sidewall section repairs possible after dismounting and qualified inspection, subject to size, location and maker; some bead-area cord damage is not repairable. US commercial-tire technical guidance, not an Italian legal exemption.

Michelin, https://www.michelinman.com/auto/auto-tips-and-advice/tire-maintenance/can-my-tire-be-repaired — passenger-car sidewall cuts require replacement in this manufacturer guidance, not universal proof for all commercial tyres.

rows.text: Check the reference pressure when cold: driving heats the tire and raises its pressure, so a hot reading cannot be directly compared with the cold value.
evidence: https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — pressione corretta per carico e impiego; controllo a freddo; pressioni errate compromettono sicurezza, aderenza e comfort.

evidence: https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — pressione corretta per carico e impiego; controllo a freddo; pressioni errate compromettono sicurezza, aderenza e comfort.

issues.reason: Il quesito dichiara FALSO che una pressione superiore del 10% a quella consigliata permetta un risparmio di carburante. Uno studio EPA su pneumatici per trattori-rimorchi rileva invece una riduzione della resistenza al rotolamento proprio passando dal 100% al 110% della pressione di riferimento; il quesito non specifica ulteriori condizioni. È incerto come conciliare il verdetto con tale effetto fisico senza attribuirgli una premessa assente.
checked_sources: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6198682/ — studio EPA: dal 100% al 110% della pressione di riferimento la resistenza al rotolamento diminuisce nelle prove di pneumatici per veicoli pesanti.
https://doi.org/10.4271/800087 — prove SAE: la resistenza al rotolamento si riduce aumentando la pressione, con effetto decrescente.

https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — il costruttore raccomanda la pressione appropriata al carico e segnala rischi del sovragonfiaggio, senza dimostrare che esso non possa ridurre il consumo.

issues.reason: The cited UNECE thermal-study PDF returns HTTP 403; provide the exact document for independent inspection or an accessible replacement supporting the temperature-variation claim.

The source says 10% over recommended pressure permits saving, not that saving is guaranteed. Explaining only that it does not ensure a saving changes the premise. State the bounded test/model result and preserve the uncertainty that its reference pressure was not established as the manufacturer-recommended pressure; do not assert a universal absence of savings.
The cited Michelin micasset/661896 PDF returns HTTP 404; provide its exact complete version or an accessible manufacturer source for truck tyre load/pressure tables and wheel limits.

The unconditional instruction to replace every tyre with a sidewall cut and never repair it generalizes a Michelin passenger-car example to all tyres. USTMA commercial truck/bus guidance permits certain section repairs after specialist inspection, subject to injury and manufacturer limits. Distinguish the particular damage and tyre category; never claim an Italian universal repair authorization.
